item.title: Glassy Desk 0.2.7
item.description:
Finish screen-access approval during setup, before your first connection. The new Direct Screen Access step explains macOS’s request to bypass the private window picker and lets you confirm access locally. After updating, open Permissions on your Mac and complete this step once before connecting.

Screen Recording and Accessibility status now refresh when you return to Glassy Desk or reselect its window. Check Again also refreshes the setup cards without restarting the app.

Pairing is simpler with the Older Glassy Desk option removed. QR codes use the current format with automatic Wi-Fi and VPN route selection.

item.title: Glassy Desk 0.2.6
item.description:
Enable Screen Recording and Accessibility with a floating guide that opens the right place in System Settings and lets you drag Glassy Desk into the permission list.

A new setup card shows your progress, and permissions refresh when you return to Glassy Desk. Available displays update as soon as Screen Recording is allowed.

item.title: Glassy Desk 0.2.5
item.description:
Adds support for Paste to Mac in compatible Glassy Desk iPhone and iPad builds. Copy text on your device, then use Paste to Mac or Cmd-V while the remote desktop has focus to paste into the active Mac app. Requires Fast Connection.

Supports multiline text, emoji, and other Unicode characters, with up to 1 MB per paste. Clipboard transfer happens only when you paste, using the existing encrypted connection and native iOS paste actions to avoid repeated clipboard permission prompts.

item.title: Glassy Desk 0.2.4
item.description:
Glassy Host is now Glassy Desk, matching the app on your iPhone and iPad.

- A cleaner blue monitor icon makes Glassy Desk easier to spot in the Dock.
- Updated menus, settings, and setup messages use the same name throughout the Mac app.
- Clearer wording explains how to share your Mac with your iPhone or iPad.

Your paired devices and settings carry over to this update.

item.title: Glassy Host 0.2.3
item.description: Fixes an issue where double-tapping during a Glassy Stream session was treated as separate single clicks on the Mac, preventing files and folders from opening. Double clicks now follow your Mac's double-click speed setting.

item.title: Glassy Host 0.2.2
item.description: Maintenance rebuild of Glassy Host for macOS 14 and later. Streaming, pairing, and update behavior are unchanged from version 0.2.1.

item.title: Glassy Host 0.2.1
item.description: Glassy Host now offers a compatibility QR code for older Glassy Desk clients, using the preferred active Tailscale or VPN route. Current clients continue to use secure identity-bound pairing with automatic LAN, Tailscale, and WireGuard route selection.

A redesigned native Mac interface, simpler QR pairing, and individual device access controls.

QR scanning requires the updated Glassy Desk client. Existing code/password pairing and saved-device authentication remain compatible.
